steps.say: Lung scarring is the killer of more connective tissue patients than joints ever are. Scleroderma is the leader at up to 80 percent with myositis close behind. HRCT is the namer of the pattern while breathing tests track the fall. Every new cough in these diseases requires imaging.
steps.tx: Scarred lungs decide survival in systemic autoimmunity: **CTD-ILD** (interstitial disease of connective tissue disorders) peaks in systemic sclerosis (up to **80 percent**), visits rheumatoid arthritis (**10 to 30 percent**), and haunts antisynthetase myositis (up to **70 percent**). Dry cough with breathlessness in these patients earns high-resolution CT first, because pattern picks therapy.

steps.say: HRCT is the separator of NSIP ground glass from UIP honeycombing. Scleroderma, myositis, and lupus are NSIP diseases while rheumatoid is a UIP disease. Basilar ground glass with traction bronchiectasis indicates NSIP. Subpleural honeycombing instead indicates UIP disease.
steps.tx: High-resolution CT (**HRCT**, thin slice lung imaging) is the diagnostic gold standard. Non-specific interstitial pneumonia (**NSIP**, uniform ground glass) with basilar ground-glass opacities, reticulation, and traction **bronchiectasis** (pulled open airways) leads in SSc, myositis, and SLE. Usual interstitial pneumonia (**UIP**, patchy fibrosis) with subpleural **honeycombing** (clustered cysts) leads in RA. Basilar ground glass indicates NSIP while honeycombing indicates UIP.

steps.say: Breathing tests show restriction with falling vital capacity and gas transfer. FVC and DLCO are tracked every few months. A 5 percent FVC fall or 10 percent DLCO fall marks progression. Symptoms alone are never the stagers of the disease.
steps.tx: Small stiff lungs with poor gas uptake define the physiology: forced vital capacity (**FVC**, exhaled volume) shrinks while **DLCO** (carbon monoxide uptake) sinks. Repeated pairs every few months chart the slope. Dropping **5 percent** or more of FVC, or **10 percent** or more of DLCO, marks physiological progression toward antifibrotic add-on. The numbers stage disease, never symptoms.

steps.say: Mycophenolate 3 g daily for 2 years is the equal of cyclophosphamide with superior safety. SLS II made it first-line for CTD-ILD. Cyclophosphamide is reserved for the most severe cases. Lung function, not symptoms, is the judge of the response.
steps.tx: **SLS II** (Scleroderma Lung Study II) matched two years of oral **mycophenolate** (MMF target **3 g** daily) against one year of oral **cyclophosphamide** for FVC preservation, with kinder safety. MMF opens immunosuppression for CTD-ILD everywhere. Cyclophosphamide waits for fulminant cases where gonadal and bladder risks are accepted. A flat FVC at 2 years indicates victory.

steps.say: Nintedanib 150 mg twice daily slows FVC decline by 44 to 57 percent across fibrosing diseases. SENSCIS and INBUILD proved the effect. Liver tests run monthly for 3 months. Diarrhoea is managed, not a reason to stop.
steps.tx: Twice daily **nintedanib 150 mg** brakes scarring across diagnoses: annual FVC loss shrank **44 to 57 percent** in SENSCIS (SSc-ILD) and INBUILD (all progressive fibrosing CTD-ILDs) by jamming PDGF, FGF, and VEGF receptor kinases. Livers are watched before the first tablet and monthly for **3 months**, easing dose when transaminases top **3 times** normal. Fibrosis marching on despite immunosuppression indicates add-on nintedanib.

vis.alt: Treatment algorithm for progressive fibrosis with nintedanib monitoring and INBUILD trial context.
vis.caption: Progressive fibrosis takes nintedanib with liver monitoring and INBUILD backing. Pirfenidone is avoided in renal failure. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Tocilizumab is the steadier of lung volumes in early diffuse scleroderma with raised reactants. FocuSSced data earned its approval for SSc-ILD. Joints and skin improve together with lungs. Early inflammatory disease is the window.
steps.tx: **Tocilizumab** (IL-6 receptor blockade) stabilized FVC in early active diffuse SSc with raised acute-phase reactants in the focuSSced trial and phase 3 data, gaining SSc-ILD approval. Skin, joints, and lungs improve together under IL-6 blockade. Early inflammatory diffuse disease with raised CRP indicates tocilizumab before fibrosis fixes.

steps.say: Antisynthetase lung disease is the racer with Jo-1, PL-7, and PL-12 antibodies. Steroids are paired with mycophenolate, tacrolimus, or rituximab. Mechanic's hands with breathlessness are the shortcut of the workup. Delay is the risk of irreversible fibrosis.
steps.tx: Antisynthetase ILD races ahead with anti-**Jo-1**, anti-PL-7, or anti-**PL-12** antibodies, often outpacing muscle disease. Therapy pairs high-dose glucocorticoids with **mycophenolate**, **tacrolimus** (calcineurin blockade), or **rituximab**. **Mechanic's hands** (cracked fingertips) with breathlessness indicate the synthetase panel at once, because delay risks fixed fibrosis.

vis.alt: Cracked hyperkeratotic fingertips of mechanic's hands in antisynthetase syndrome.
vis.caption: Cracked fingertips with breathlessness shortcut to the synthetase panel. Rapid ILD here needs triple therapy early. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Progressive fibrosis needs 2 of 3 within a year with worse symptoms, lung function fall, and CT spread. Meeting the bar qualifies for antifibrotics. Acute exacerbations with new ground glass carry above 50 percent inpatient mortality. Both are emergencies of tempo.
steps.tx: Fibrosis on the march earns the progressive label when **2 of 3** worsen inside a year: breathlessness deepening, FVC down **5 percent** or more with DLCO down **10 percent** or more, and CT scars spreading, unlocking add-on antifibrotic tablets. A sudden white-out of new ground glass over weeks is an acute exacerbation, killing above **50 percent** of admissions without steroids, antibiotics, and intensive care review. Speed decides urgency.

nodes.label: Two of three within a year
